title: Multi-armed Bandits
summary: These lecture notes present the Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) algorithm for solving the multi-armed bandit problem with Bernoulli rewards. The paper provides a formal analysis of the UCB algorithm, proves that it achieves logarithmic regret in T (the number of rounds), and demonstrates that this approach is superior to naive certainty equivalence strategies which suffer linear regret.
notes:
--- From MCTS, Bandits, and AlphaZero: Planning and Exploration in RL ---
Detailed treatment. Only Bernoulli (but that also applies to sub-Gaussian, right?). Also includes a proof.
